concerns.text: The plan relies on a placeholder Zenodo URL ("<ZENODO_URL>") and a placeholder NIST API endpoint (" No address associated with hostname)")], which are empty and do not point to any real, accessible dataset containing CCSD(T)/CBS reference energies and XYZ coordinates.
